description: Publish websites from your agent to your own Cloudflare account, then edit, undo, export or unpublish them from any later chat.

PUBLISHER_URL.description: The MCP URL of your own Publisher, from its control panel under AI connections. It ends in /mcp, for example https://publisher-1a2b3c4d.your-name.workers.dev/mcp. Install a Publisher first at https://publisher.jumpermcp.dev.
